package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"golang.org/x/net/html"
	"golang.org/x/net/html/atom"
)

const sourceExpected = SOURCE_LITERAL
const sourceDefaults = DEFAULTS_LITERAL

type fixtureNode struct {
	Type            html.NodeType
	Data, Namespace string
	Attr            []html.Attribute
	Children        []fixtureNode
}

func fixtureShape(n *html.Node) fixtureNode {
	out := fixtureNode{Type: n.Type, Data: n.Data, Namespace: n.Namespace, Attr: append([]html.Attribute(nil), n.Attr...)}
	for child := n.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
		out.Children = append(out.Children, fixtureShape(child))
	}
	return out
}

func fixtureFragment(t *testing.T, body string) []fixtureNode {
	t.Helper()
	nodes, err := html.ParseFragment(strings.NewReader(body), &html.Node{Type: html.ElementNode, Data: "div", DataAtom: atom.Div})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("parse failed")
	}
	out := make([]fixtureNode, 0, len(nodes))
	for _, node := range nodes {
		out = append(out, fixtureShape(node))
	}
	return out
}

func fixtureRender(t *testing.T, component interface {
	Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
}) string {
	t.Helper()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("render failed")
	}
	return out.String()
}

func fixtureDefaults(t *testing.T) FAQ {
	t.Helper()
	var data FAQ
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(sourceDefaults), &data); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("defaults decode failed")
	}
	return data
}

func fixtureWrite(t *testing.T, env, body string) {
	t.Helper()
	name := os.Getenv(env)
	if name == "" {
		return
	}
	f, err := os.OpenFile(name, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("private fixture create failed")
	}
	_, writeErr := io.WriteString(f, body)
	syncErr := f.Sync()
	closeErr := f.Close()
	if writeErr != nil || syncErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
		t.Fatal("private fixture write failed")
	}
}

func fixtureNativeModel(body string, models []FAQ) error {
	nodes, err := html.ParseFragment(strings.NewReader(body), &html.Node{Type: html.ElementNode, Data: "div", DataAtom: atom.Div})
	if err != nil || len(nodes) != len(models) {
		return fmt.Errorf("native instance count")
	}
	var descendants func(*html.Node, string) []*html.Node
	descendants = func(n *html.Node, tag string) (out []*html.Node) {
		if n.Type == html.ElementNode && n.Data == tag { out = append(out, n) }
		for c := n.FirstChild; c != nil; c = c.NextSibling { out = append(out, descendants(c, tag)...) }
		return
	}
	var text func(*html.Node) string
	text = func(n *html.Node) (out string) {
		if n.Type == html.TextNode { return n.Data }
		for c := n.FirstChild; c != nil; c = c.NextSibling { out += text(c) }
		return
	}
	attr := func(n *html.Node, key string) (string, bool) {
		for _, a := range n.Attr { if a.Key == key { return a.Val, true } }
		return "", false
	}
	for i, model := range models {
		headings, items := descendants(nodes[i], "h2"), descendants(nodes[i], "details")
		if len(headings) != 1 || text(headings[0]) != model.Heading || len(items) != len(model.Items) { return fmt.Errorf("native heading/items %d", i) }
		for j, item := range model.Items {
			summaries, paragraphs, divs := descendants(items[j], "summary"), descendants(items[j], "p"), descendants(items[j], "div")
			_, open := attr(items[j], "open")
			if len(summaries) != 1 || len(paragraphs) != 1 || len(divs) < 1 || open != item.Open { return fmt.Errorf("native state %d/%d", i, j) }
			spans := descendants(summaries[0], "span")
			id, _ := attr(divs[0], "id")
			if len(spans) < 1 || text(spans[0]) != item.Question || text(paragraphs[0]) != item.Answer || id != model.IDPrefix+"-"+item.Key { return fmt.Errorf("native content/identity %d/%d", i, j) }
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func TestFirstPartyFAQFixture(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureDefaults(t)
	reference, err := NewFAQReference(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("reference constructor failed")
	}
	referenceBody := fixtureRender(t, reference)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(fixtureFragment(t, sourceExpected), fixtureFragment(t, referenceBody)) {
		t.Fatal("source/reference namespace-aware DOM, text, classes, attributes, or comments differ")
	}

	first := data
	first.IDPrefix = "help-primary"
	first.Items = append([]FAQItem(nil), data.Items...)
	second := data
	second.IDPrefix = "help-secondary"
	second.Heading = strings.Repeat("H", 256)
	second.Items = append([]FAQItem(nil), data.Items...)
	for i := range second.Items {
		second.Items[i].Question = strings.Repeat(string(rune('A'+i)), 480)
		second.Items[i].Answer = strings.Repeat(string(rune('a'+i)), 4096)
	}
	one, err := NewFAQDetails(first)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("first native constructor failed")
	}
	two, err := NewFAQDetails(second)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("second native constructor failed")
	}
	nativeBody := `<section data-fixture-instance="primary">` + fixtureRender(t, one) + `</section><section data-fixture-instance="secondary">` + fixtureRender(t, two) + `</section>`
	models := []FAQ{first, second}
	if err := fixtureNativeModel(nativeBody, models); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	for _, mutation := range []struct{ before, after string }{
		{strings.Repeat("A", 480), strings.Repeat("B", 480)},
		{strings.Repeat("a", 4096), strings.Repeat("b", 4096)},
		{"help-primary-"+first.Items[0].Key, "invented-id"},
		{"<details open", "<details data-not-open"},
	} {
		changed := strings.Replace(nativeBody, mutation.before, mutation.after, 1)
		if changed == nativeBody || fixtureNativeModel(changed, models) == nil { t.Fatal("native model drift escaped independent oracle") }
	}
	if strings.Contains(nativeBody, "el-disclosure") || strings.Contains(nativeBody, "commandfor=") ||
		strings.Count(nativeBody, "<details") != len(data.Items)*2 || strings.Count(nativeBody, "<summary") != len(data.Items)*2 {
		t.Fatal("native topology differs")
	}
	nodes, err := html.ParseFragment(strings.NewReader(nativeBody), &html.Node{Type: html.ElementNode, Data: "div", DataAtom: atom.Div})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("native parse failed")
	}
	ids := map[string]bool{}
	var walk func(*html.Node)
	walk = func(n *html.Node) {
		if n.Type == html.ElementNode {
			for _, attr := range n.Attr {
				if attr.Key == "id" {
					if attr.Val == "" || ids[attr.Val] {
						t.Fatal("duplicate native ID")
					}
					ids[attr.Val] = true
				}
			}
		}
		for child := n.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			walk(child)
		}
	}
	for _, node := range nodes {
		walk(node)
	}
	if len(ids) < len(data.Items)*2 {
		t.Fatal("derived instance IDs missing")
	}

	canceled, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	var sink bytes.Buffer
	if err := one.Render(canceled, &sink); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("cancellation was ignored")
	}

	fixtureWrite(t, "APPKIT_FAQ_REFERENCE_OUT", referenceBody)
	fixtureWrite(t, "APPKIT_FAQ_NATIVE_OUT", nativeBody)
}
